nodes.text: Fire's free, voice down. There's a camp out there we're watching instead of sleeping.

choices.text: How long have they been there?

nodes.text: There's your mark. Two of us hold this post, so it's yours or nobody's. The lamp stays lit.
Chart's got it. Wind's got their smoke. Hard to miss either.
Three nights. First night's a fire. Second's a fence. We don't talk much about what the third one usually is.
